$comment: Provider-neutral alert templates (Phase 4 automated readiness). NOT DEPLOYED: no monitoring system observes these. Every `metric` is validated against apps/api/src/observability.ts METRIC and every `labels` entry against the metric label allowlist, so a rule cannot drift from a metric that exists. Thresholds are starting values for a deployment that does not exist yet and need calibration against real traffic.

rules.name: ApiAvailabilityDegraded
rules.summary: More than 5% of API requests are failing.

rules.name: ApiReadinessFailing
rules.summary: A readiness check is failing; this instance should not take traffic.

rules.name: MigrationStateMismatch
rules.summary: Schema state does not match this build. Do not serve traffic.
rules.$comment: for: 0m is deliberate. A schema mismatch is not a transient blip and waiting does not make it safer.

rules.name: UnsafeDatabaseRole
rules.summary: The application role is not the expected least-privilege role; tenant isolation may be absent.

rules.name: QueueDelayHigh
rules.summary: Work is accumulating faster than the workers drain it.

rules.name: ProviderFailureRateHigh
rules.summary: A provider is failing a fifth of its attempts.

rules.name: ProviderRetriesElevated
rules.expr: rate over 15m exceeds twice the 24h baseline
rules.summary: Retries are well above baseline; spend is rising without more output.

rules.name: FallbackRateElevated
rules.summary: Calls are being rerouted to secondary models; cost per chapter is rising.

rules.name: RateAdmissionRejections
rules.summary: The shared limiter is refusing a large share of calls.

rules.name: RateAdmissionWaitHigh
rules.summary: Callers are queuing behind the shared rate limit.

rules.name: ConcurrencySaturated
rules.summary: Shared concurrency is exhausted; work is waiting on leases.

rules.name: BudgetRejections
rules.expr: outcome=refused increase over 10m is greater than 0
rules.summary: Work is being refused for budget; production has stopped for this scope.

rules.name: UnknownBillingAccumulating
rules.summary: Calls are settling with unknown cost; the spend figure understates reality.

rules.name: CancellationObservationDelay
rules.summary: Cancellations are not reaching running calls promptly; paid work continues after a stop.

rules.name: LateResponsesObserved
rules.summary: Providers are answering after cancellation; results are being discarded as designed.

rules.name: StaleWorkerRejections
rules.summary: Workers are being fenced out; a partitioned or slow worker is retrying stale writes.

rules.name: LeaseLossElevated
rules.summary: Workers are losing target leases mid-work.

rules.name: DatabasePoolSaturated
rules.summary: A database pool is running out of connections.

rules.name: EmbeddingGenerationFailing
rules.summary: Embedding generation is failing; a new set cannot be activated while incomplete.

rules.name: RetrievalFailing
rules.summary: Retrieval is mostly returning nothing; continuity checks are running blind.

rules.name: RestoreDrillStale
rules.summary: No restore drill has succeeded recently; recovery is unverified.

rules.name: OutputLanguageFailures
rules.summary: Manuscript roles are producing non-English output; the governing invariant is failing.

rules.name: EvaluatorRegression
rules.expr: evaluation failure ratio over 6h exceeds twice the 7d baseline
rules.summary: Evaluators are rejecting far more than baseline; a prompt or policy change may have regressed.

inhibition.$comment: A schema mismatch makes every downstream signal unreliable, so it suppresses the noise it causes rather than paging twice for one cause.
Budget refusal STOPS work by design; the resulting queue growth is the symptom, not a second incident.
